models.title: MiniCPM-V 4.7 introduces the first open-source MoE model for on-device vision
models.summary: MiniCPM-V 4.7 features a 35B-A3B variant utilizing Lookahead Expert Scheduling for lossless, smooth on-device inference across image and video tasks.
models.why: Advances efficient multi-image and video understanding capabilities directly on hardware.

models.title: Google DeepMind releases EmbeddingGemma 2, an open multimodal embedding model
models.summary: EmbeddingGemma 2 is a 740M-parameter multimodal model mapping text, images, video, and audio into a single 768-dimensional vector space for consumer hardware.
models.why: It brings efficient, low-latency semantic representations for multimodal on-device search and retrieval.

models.title: Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo accelerates text-to-image generation and editing
models.summary: An accelerated checkpoint of Qwen-Image-2.1 utilizing an 8-denoising-step pipeline with prefix KV caching for faster image generation.
models.why: Speeds up visual generation pipelines for rapid prototyping and deployment.

models.title: LiquidAI releases LFM2.5-24B-A2B reasoning model for on-device agents
models.summary: A 24B reasoning model with 2B active parameters optimized for fast, private on-device agentic and tool-use tasks.
models.why: Pushes the boundaries of efficient, low-latency reasoning and tool use for edge agents.

models.title: Qwen-Image-2.1 gets uncensored quantized GGUF and MLX formats
models.summary: Quantized versions of Qwen-Image-2.1 released in GGUF, Safetensors, and MLX formats for local image generation workflows using ComfyUI.
models.why: Enables localized, optimized deployment of advanced image generation models on diverse hardware.

models.title: Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo gets an uncensored text encoder variant
models.summary: The text encoder of Qwen-Image is modified to project out refusal directions, dropping text refusal rates while maintaining MMLU performance.
models.why: Allows unrestricted prompt handling for local stable-diffusion pipelines.
